API-mode app shell, sign-in, Account and session expiry — UX prototypes (STY-108)

Static desktop (1280px) and phone (375px) frames comparing structural alternatives for the Sheets → API app shell shift and STY-109. Single-tenant DHCW UI with clean room for a future organisation switcher, Members sidebar slot and Microsoft account linking.

Companion analysis and Decisions needed: docs/analysis/api-sign-in-and-account-ux-analysis.md.

1. Authenticated shell, identity & organisation context

How the authenticated API-mode shell shows the signed-in person (Carys Evans, Product Lead) and active organisation (Digital Health and Care Wales) across desktop 1280px (open sidebar and 64px folded rail) and phone 375px (open AccountMenu, open navigation drawer, and Welsh Mapiau Trywydd width check), keeping Theme and Edit surface in AccountMenu and placing the future Members utility slot beside Families.

2. Sign-in, refusal & zero-membership landing

Clean header-only shell (DHCW navy header + language switcher, plus Account/Sign out when signed in with zero memberships; no sidebar or search) replacing StartPage's Google Sheets copy across four states: sign-in landing, 'You haven't been invited' refusal, failed sign-in notice, and 'No organisation access' for a signed-in person with zero active memberships.

3. Account page

Shows display name, sign-in identity (provider, email, last sign-in, with room for future Microsoft account linking), organisation membership and role (with room for additional organisations), and 'Sign out everywhere' with confirmation.

4. API-mode session expiry & re-sign-in

Focused adaptation of today's SessionWarning, ReconnectDialog and AuthNotice for ADR-018 Option 15: 2-minute idle warning ('Stay signed in'), 2-minute pre-absolute-limit warning ('Sign in again' in a new tab), post-expiry / 401 dialog ('Sign in again' in a new tab keeping open edits), and tab-focus person check discarding changes when someone else signed in on the browser.
